split.test: nd42 + sherlock: 30 questions, unseen documents for selection

protocol.old_diagnostic: Original 20 Vietnamese questions are scored only after selection/test, labelled diagnostic; never used to tune or select.
protocol.filter: Only language when explicitly supplied in question/context; no gold source/page filters

strategies.D: BGE-English dense20 + BM25_20 + RRF60 top20 + English reranker top3
strategies.E: Same as D candidate retrieval but use RRF top3 directly; no reranker
strategies.F: Multilingual E5-small ONNX INT8 dense top3 + filter
strategies.G: E5-small dense20 + same BM25_20/RRF60 top3; no reranker

protocol.shared_chunking: All use same paragraph max1000 chunks, physical page/unit and existing chapter boundaries; no chunk tuning.
protocol.selection: Max dev Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then lower mean retrieval latency, then strategy name; select among C,D,E,F,G before any test query retrieval.
protocol.claim: Potential improvements are hypotheses; report all results including regressions. Model changes are explicit E vs G, C vs F; no claim of same model across all five.
limitations: Source-reviewed questions, not independent human labels.
One dev document, two test documents; small sample; source/language mix can affect selection.
PDF OCR spelling retained; historical regulations not current legal advice.
Strict full-quote single-chunk metric may reject equivalent evidence; recorded exact alternatives accepted.
Known source text indexed before testing is normal retrieval evaluation; gold/test labels not used for fitting.
